title: Marguerite and the Vow
author: Jonah Ashgrove
blurb: Silas Thackeray, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
